effective_date_basis: The earliest of: own terms, a superseding order, the Commonwealth transition, X1-E4.
ending_pattern: Candidate end: Philippine independence on July 4, 1946 (event X1-E4); some ended with the 1935 Commonwealth, and reservations retained under the 1947 bases agreement did not end in 1946.

exemplar.wpa_summary: All matters pertaining to the Government of the Philip pine Islandsplaced under the jurisdictionof the Insular AffairsBureau, War Dept.

legal_effect: Research pattern only. A type rule never fills a judgment field, establishes an end, a date, a status or savings for any order, and never substitutes for reading the order's own text.
outlier_conditions: The order's own text (not only the WPA summary or APP title) does not match the type, or the held text is another order's.
The order does more than the type's single act (a second operative clause of another kind).
A later order or statute amends, extends, revokes or revives it before the candidate end.
The order states its own effective date, duration, condition or termination that differs from the pattern.
Orders whose Philippine mention is incidental (for example a civil-service schedule covering many places).
quoted_clause:
."He (the Governor General of the Philippine Islands) shall annually and at such other times as he may be required make such official report of the transactions of the government of the Philippine Islands to an executive department of the United States to be designated by the President, and his said annual report shall be transmitted to the Congress of the United States; And he shall perform such additional duties and functions as may in pursuance of law be delegated or assigned to him by the President."

Under this provision hereafter all official reports which the GovernorGeneral of the Philippine Islands may be required to make of the transactions of the Government of the Philippine Islan
